title: diplomacyR 0.1.0
text: First release. dp_map() loads standard seven-power board: 75 provinces, per-coast fleet adjacency, 34 supply centres canonical opening position. dp_adjudicate() resolves movement phases standard rules, including support cutting, convoy paths, convoy paradoxes, standoffs self-dislodgement prohibitions. engine passes every movement-phase case Diplomacy Adjudicator Test Cases (DATC section 6.-6.G). dp_retreat(), dp_build() dp_advance() complete phase machine; dp_step() dp_play() drive whole games. Bots (dp_ai_orders()), batch simulation (dp_simulate()) analysis (dp_stats(), dp_power_summary()). ggplot2 renderers board, supply-centre histories simulation dashboards. shiny application, dp_run_app(), interactive play.
